answer: Each identity buys one saffron seal from the registry vault, priced by order per verified ID hash: first $10, second $20, third $30, so the k-th seal costs k times $10. A licensed registrar plants each seal in the public garden ledger after an in-person ID check, so no seal is minted twice or in secret. 1,000 puppets on one ID cost $10 x (1+2+...+1000) = $5,005,000 in bonds locked in the vault, slashed on proven fraud, while an honest user pays $10 once, refunded after a clean year. Fresh IDs cannot reset the price: one human holds one ID, and each needs its own in-person check.
